import pathlib,urllib.request,hashlib,tarfile,subprocess,base64,os
root=pathlib.Path.home()/'.cache/devin-harness-20261102'
root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
bundle=root/'devin-linux-x64.tar.gz'
url='https://static.devin.ai/cli/3000.11.234/devin-3000.11.234-x86_64-unknown-linux.tar.gz'
urllib.request.urlretrieve(url,bundle)
assert hashlib.sha256(bundle.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='201370cddd2924294e3ca6b46fd8ece49b5763953b644a1dd823fce5490cb41a'
print('Linux x64 bundle SHA-256 verified',flush=True)
with tarfile.open(bundle) as archive:archive.extractall(root/'cli',filter='data')
probe=root/'probe-cli.py'
probe.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(''))
subprocess.run(['python3',str(probe),'--cli',str(root/'cli/bin/devin')],check=True,env=dict(os.environ,TMPDIR=str(root)))
